basic_details.job_title: APCRDA Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Manager, Assistant Manager Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority

qualification.education_qualification: Chartered Accountant (ICAI) or MBA/PGDM Finance or CFA or Master's in Economics/Finance
qualification.details: Manager-Fund Mobilisation: Chartered Accountant (ICAI); or MBA / PGDM with specialisation in Finance; or CFA Charter holder; or Master’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Public Finance or any other relevant discipline. Minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in infrastructure or project finance, development / multilateral lending, debt capital markets, or public-sector treasury and debt management. Assistant Manager-Fund Mobilisation: Chartered Accountant (ICAI); or MBA / PGDM with specialisation in Finance; or CFA (Level II cleared or above); or Master’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Commerce or other relevant discipline. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience including exposure to debt servicing or treasury operations, infrastructure / project finance, credit / ratings, or financial management of externally aided projects.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the APCRDA Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of APCRDA to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download APCRDA Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: APCRDA Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Manager-Fund Mobilisation and 1 for Assistant Manager-Fund Mobilisation.

content_sections.heading: APCRDA Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Manager-Fund Mobilisation: Chartered Accountant (ICAI); or MBA / PGDM with specialisation in Finance; or CFA Charter holder; or Master’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Public Finance or any other relevant discipline. Minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in infrastructure or project finance, development / multilateral lending, debt capital markets, or public-sector treasury and debt management. Assistant Manager-Fund Mobilisation: Chartered Accountant (ICAI); or MBA / PGDM with specialisation in Finance; or CFA (Level II cleared or above); or Master’s Degree in Economics, Finance, Commerce or other relevant discipline. Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience including exposure to debt servicing or treasury operations, infrastructure / project finance, credit / ratings, or financial management of externally aided projects.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the APCRDA Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of APCRDA to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the APCRDA recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the APCRDA recruitment is 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Manager-Fund Mobilisation / Assistant Manager-Fund Mobilisation posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Manager-Fund Mobilisation and Assistant Manager-Fund Mobilisation posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered ranges from Rs. 1,00,000 to Rs. 1,50,000 per month, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: The qualifications include Chartered Accountant (ICAI), MBA/PGDM Finance, CFA, or a Master's degree in Economics/Finance, with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for APCRDA recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contract.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the APCRDA located?
faq.answer: APCRDA is located in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, with the pincode 522237.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from other states apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions, but it is advisable to check the official notification for detailed eligibility.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links to the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
